title: Consume structured assembly-conflict and server events
goal: Read assembly-reference conflicts and build-server lifecycle records when a build observer needs machine-readable dependency relationships and a reliable explanation of server selection.

selectionNotes: Select the build/logger/replay host separately from the application TFM. This is the actual SDK11 event boundary; no SDK10 typed route is advertised.
SDK10 retains a real verified CLI/binlog and stable warning-code alternative. Server reuse itself is not new.
Use supported CLI invocation, not the unsupported third-party MSBuildClient/OutOfProcServerNode embedding surface.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Exact runtime used by the SDK-bound logger/replay consumer; actual GA remains unqualified.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: The actual bundled MSBuild18.12 event producer/reader and compiler/dependency/resolver closure are hash qualified together.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Pinned example language mode; event consumption does not independently require a new language feature.

packageAssets: Actual SDK Microsoft.Build, Framework, Utilities and Tasks.Core 18.12.0-1.26504.105, Private=false; full MSBuild.deps.json/resolver closure checked. No independent NuGet replacement, no public18.11 byte equivalence claim.
platforms: Windows x64, exact .NET-hosted SDK/ref/runtime/native-host assets. Other OSes, Visual Studio/.NET Framework and NativeAOT are unqualified.
prerequisites: Complete .NET11 RC2 SDK installation, rollForward=disable and allowPrerelease=true; original controlled strong-named assembly graph and trusted project inputs.
SDK10.0.402/runtime+ref10.0.13 and C#14 additionally reproduce the older fallback. Exact installed artifacts are recorded separately in the sample pin manifest.
PowerShell7 for sample evidence/installed inspection. No external provider, rendering mode, workload, optional native compiler or device is required.
constraints: Conflict/search/details constructors are internal. Observe actual emitted events; hand-created events establish only constructor controls.
Diagnostic verbosity/matched binary reader are required for the complete low-importance records. Warning promotion can emit an ordinary error instead of a typed warning.

Use a unique child-only MSBUILDNODEHANDSHAKESALT in this pinned diagnostic fixture. Retain and validate owned server handles; stop only those handles. This implementation knob is not a promised general isolation API.
No universal reuse/performance guarantee, server private-API hosting recommendation, older-target API backport or independent package compatibility claim.
Keep raw binlogs/private paths local. Publish redacted graph-relative relationships. Retrieval executes no consumer code.
optIns: MSBUILDUSESERVER=1 only in fixture children; MSBUILDUSESERVER=0 disables it. Requested server plus -nr:false produces NotUsed without -mt; no experimental -mt is used.
No ExperimentalAttribute diagnostic or preview-language suppression is required by these event APIs. RC2 SDK pin explicitly allows prerelease.
stabilityLimitations: Preview-qualified exact SDK observation; new conflict records are gated by the18.12 feature wave. Do not disable the wave to claim typed emission.
The eight approved .NET10 foundations, PIN-959 qualifying evidence, PIN-963/actual-GA and unrelated Human gates remain open.

evidence.scope: Actual strong-named graph, MSB3277 and diagnostic binlog replay; CLI spawn/reuse/no-server task PID controls, real warning-as-error failure, text constructor and absent typed APIs. Exact complete SDK closure checked; no typed older route.

Actual strong-named graph emits typed warning, non-warning dependency details and failed searches; matched binlog replay preserves victor/victim/loss/dependee/source/search fields. Actual Spawned/Reused same owned PID, requested no-reuse NotUsed reason, disabled absence; warning promotion fails with MSB3277. Event/text constructor controls and owned-handle cleanup; exact complete SDK closure. Windows x64 RC2 only.

humanProof.scope: Real local CLI/binlog/lifecycle and failure execution cover this managed observer goal. No Human/provider/device/native-compiler claim. PIN-959/PIN-963/actual-GA and unrelated Human gates remain open.
